A type of '''military transport''' was utilized by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It had a double-wing configuration and served in various roles, including that of a troop dropship, bomber, or transport. This model was utilized during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]]. During that battle, it was used in strafing runs on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], which was reduced to rubble as a result. During the Cold War, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team known as [[Havoc Squad]] tracked down one of these transports in use by the Empire to a remote canyon in the eastern [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], where it was reported to transport a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] operative. Havoc Squad successfully extracted the operative, destroying the transport in the process.
